source: FLHSMV Driver License Operations Manual MP08 (Revised 03.18.25), extracted 2026-04-30 via scripts/build-ops-manual-index.ts

fees.label: Class E Driver License (original or renewal)
Commercial Driver License — School Employee (with employment proof)
Delinquent Renewal (within 1 year of expiration)
fees.note: Waivable by passing the full Class E knowledge exam.

fees.label: Hazardous Materials Endorsement (CDL) — includes TSA background check
Tax Collector Service Fee
fees.note: Charged per transaction at the tax collector office on top of the state fee.

fees.label: Disabled Person Parking Permit — temporary placard (original or renewal)
fees.note: Per HSMV-Temp and F-83039 §3, the temporary placard fee is $15. Statute distributes the fee: $3.50 DHSMV trust fund, $2.50 tax collector processing, $4.00 Vocational Rehabilitation, $5.00 Transportation Disadvantaged Trust Fund.

fees.label: Disabled Person Parking Permit — visitor temporary placard
fees.note: Visitor temporary applies when an out-of-state or out-of-country visitor does not have an ISA-marked home placard. Visitor temporary is non-renewable; must re-apply on expiration.

fees.label: Disabled Person Parking Permit — replacement (lost / damaged / defaced / surrendered / stolen-without-report)
fees.note: Replacement fee is retained by the issuing agency.

fees.label: Disabled Person Parking Permit — permanent placard (4-year, blue)
fees.note: Permanent placards are issued at no charge. Verified TCSLC-218, HSMV-Perm, F-83039 §3.

noFeeConditions.description: Veteran designation added to an existing credential — no fee with DD-214 or VA ID card.

100% total-and-permanent disabled veteran — no fee for the original, renewal, or replacement of a Class E DL, ID card, or CDL (including any delinquent-renewal fee). Qualifies with EITHER a valid Florida Dept. of Veterans' Affairs ID card OR a VA 'Summary of Benefits' letter showing a permanent, service-connected 100% disability (a temporary 100% rating does not qualify). [Confirmed by TCSLC staff — policy-questions DL-7, 2026-07.]
Defective card (manufacturing or examiner error) — no fee replacement.
Stolen card replacement with valid police report — no fee.
Homeless applicant or applicant at/below 100% federal poverty level — no fee for ID card.
Second temporary placard issued within 12 months of the prior temporary — fee waived.
noFeeConditions.note: Statute: 'No person will be required to pay a fee … more than once in a 12-month period from the date of the prior fee payment.'

noFeeConditions.description: Replacement placard for a stolen permit with a valid police report — fee waived.
Replacement placard for a permit lost in transit within 180 days of issuance — fee waived.
Disabled-person parking permits issued to qualifying organizations — no fee per the permanent-placard class. One placard per registered fleet vehicle, valid up to 4 years, expiring June 30.
noFeeConditions.note: HSMV-Org is silent on fees; permanent class is $0 and organizations are issued the same form factor.
